title: How can I upscale my RPG Maker XP sprites?

posts.author: AriSaitou
posts.body: Hello, I was planning to use RPG Maker XP Sprites for a game I'll make on RPG Maker MV as for me, they're visually the best-looking sprites.. but they seem a bit pixel-y as well. So, for better quality.. what can I use to upscale the sprites?

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
I find that the xBRZ algorithm does a really good job of upscaling pixel art. You could try
this online service
for a quick test to see if you like it; there's likely a downloadable option available somewhere too, which may be better if you need to upscale a lot of images. If it looks good, just google "xbrz upscale" and pick one you like.
EDIT: It does have a disadvantage of being limited to integer multiples, so you'd get 64x64 sprites instead of 48x48 sprites. You might be able to scale them back down using GIMP though; not sure how that would look however. Or you could just use the 64x64 sprites as-is in MV, as there's no limit on sprite size.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Solar_Flare said:
It does have a disadvantage of being limited to integer multiples

that is because any non-integer multiple is guaranteed to have at least some quality loss, and even the best zoom algorithm can't prevent that, they can only reduce quality loss but not eliminate it for non-integer multiples.
